speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started, and has it been getting worse gradually or suddenly? Also, have you noticed any redness, warmth, or fever associated with the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That mechanism of injury sounds like a classic "Jersey Finger," which is an avulsion of the flexor tendon. Can you make a fist and tell me if your right ring finger stays straight while the others curl in?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: That inability to flex the distal joint confirms my suspicion of a Jersey Finger. I need to assess the blood supply and rule out associated fractures, so REQUEST TEST: Finger_X-Ray and REQUEST TEST: Doppler_Ulnar_Artery.
